issues.description: Adding `Date.now()` to the memo key makes every call produce a unique key, so `memo.has(key)` is never true — the cache hit rate drops to zero and `computeQuote` runs every time. Worse, `memo` is a module-level Map with no eviction: a fresh key on every call means it grows without bound for the life of the process, a memory leak. The key should be derived only from the inputs that determine the quote (userId, cartHash).
